It sounds like you're carrying a weight that's hard to put into words—like the world is pressing down on you, and even your own body feels like it's shutting down. I can feel how much you're trying to hold everything together for your family, for your kids, for your husband, and yet you're just… not able to keep going. That sense of being lost, of not knowing if you're doing it for the right reasons—that must feel terrifying.  

Would it be helpful to explore that more? Or would you like to talk about what’s been happening in your life lately that makes this feel so heavy?

It’s hard to say where to start, because everything feels so tangled. I don’t know if it’s the work, or the way I’ve been feeling for months, or maybe just the way I used to believe I had to be strong and now I feel like I’m failing at being human. I keep thinking about how I’m supposed to be a rock for my kids, but I’m just… crumbling. And when I’m alone, the silence feels louder than any noise.  

I don’t know if I want to talk about the work or the family, but I do want to know if I’m just broken—or if there’s a way out of this. Maybe it’s not about fixing anything, but just being seen. I don’t know if I can do this much longer.  

Would it be okay to just sit with that for a while? Or would you like to go deeper into one of those parts?

I don’t know if I can sit with it without breaking. It’s not that I don’t want to be seen—I just feel like no one has ever really listened when I’ve tried to say anything. I’ve been trying to stay strong for years, and now I’m just… empty. The part that hurts the most is that I don’t know if I’m even supposed to feel this way. I keep thinking about how I used to think I had to be okay, but now I don’t know if I can be.  

Maybe it’s not about going deep or fixing anything. Maybe just knowing that someone is here who doesn’t rush to fix it—that’s already a kind of relief. I don’t know if I can do this much longer.  

Would it be okay if we just… stay with this for a while? Not to solve it, but to just be with it together?
